name: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the retail sale of pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and daily good products in Japan. The company offers medicines; health foods such, as vitamin supplements and dietary supplements; first aid supplies; health management and medical supplies; beauty counseling cosmetics; and facial care products, including face washes; andbody care products, such as body soaps. It also provides shampoos; toothpaste; diapers and other baby-related products, nursing care products, sanitary products, detergents, household goods, pet food, socks and underwear, clothing, and home appliances; and processed foods, daily foods, fresh foods, seasonings, sweets, drinks, and alcoho…
